name: The Lamp Chain (Đăng Liên Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Not One Lamp Out (Bất Nhất Đăng Diệt)
bonuses.rule: while you cast no escape art, your ward seals do not burn out, and each seal that turns a blow passes one more turn to the next seal in the line (+1 % ward strength per passed turn). If you cast an escape art, every seal burns out after 3 s.

story: The lamp he lit the night Kim Sa drowned, the drowned tower's seal the divers brought up in 920, and a diver's robe like the one his sworn brother wore. The hall believes the set was the founder's. Only the seal was, and all three are about one night.

name: The Breakwater (Phá Lãng Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each blow your shield or wards turn adds a layer that fades after 5 s, and each layer cuts the damage you take by a further 4 %. At five or more layers your next seal spends them all and lays 2 Heavy Breath on the foe, and one more for every five layers past five.

story: The basalt seal, the shield she made for a wall no one built and the shard of the wall that cracked. All three are hers, and none of them is the hall's. That is the argument she has with Ôn Thủ Đăng.
